name: Oscilloscope Graphics
visualIdentity: Explicit: a dark background with a small set of glowing vectors for waveforms, trajectories, and contours. Modest persistence keeps paths clear. Stable zones are reserved for text instead of arbitrary line wobble. Provenance is explicit, and the source notes that this treatment requires defined signal behavior.
suitableUses: Explicit: audio-reactive or Lissajous pieces driven by a real signal, music visualizers, album teasers, live-set backdrops rendered offline, and physics, audio-engineering, or signal-processing education. Inferred: product or explanatory pieces where traces teach a concept.
limitations: Traces must derive from verified audio data or explicit functions, never random noise. Live microphone input is excluded from rendered output. Strobing brightness on every beat should be avoided. Raster CRT scanlines must not be added to this vector display. Multiple crossing traces can become illegible. Use is unsuitable where no defined signal exists.
palette: Authored suggestion, not a supplied palette. Background #081613 is the dominant dark field. Foreground #D8F0DD is for labels and text. Accent #76CF9B is reserved for traces. Gradients are disabled, so use discrete tokens. Opaque two-color contrast is 15.362 for foreground on background and 9.845 for accent on background, both above the 4.5 normal-text target. These checks do not cover video, glow, or animated light. Task-supplied exact colors override these tokens.
motionAndInteraction: Explicit: motion is driven by a defined signal or precomputed audio, with fixed sampling and persistence rules. Persistence and line weight stay constant across sections. Figure families change only at verified section boundaries. Interactive HTML may use play/pause keyboard controls, a static waveform fallback, and a pre-analyzed signal table indexed by playback time for deterministic seeking. Catalog motions motion-012, motion-014, and motion-015 are optional and need scene support; none is required.
audio: The source specifies no fixed audio layer. Audio-reactive use requires precomputed analysis for offline rendering, with traces synchronized to the same time data. Music-sync hybrids change trace shapes at section boundaries from a shared event table. Music, voiceover, and sound effects are otherwise unspecified. Inferred: narration for educational uses must remain intelligible over the traces.
assetRequirements: Explicit requirements: precomputed signal data from verified audio analysis or explicit functions, plus a shared event table when music structure drives changes. Stable reserved text zones are required. Specific asset files, fonts, and audio sources are unspecified and must be supplied or authorized. No 3D engine asset is required. Formula labels in education hybrids must exactly match the plotted functions.
combinations: Oscilloscope Graphics alone suits real-signal audio-reactive or Lissajous work. Hybrid with style-105: a beat and section event table drives trace changes at verified boundaries with constant persistence. Hybrid with style-097: explicit function plots, a faint graticule, and labels, with the accent kept for the trace and labels in the foreground color. Avoid simultaneous crossing traces and raster scanlines in either hybrid.
productionApproach: Style renderer: Canvas 2D draws vectors, paths, and persistence at deterministic frame times from shared composition time. Motion is signal-derived, and no specific motion engine is mandated. Web Audio API serves preview inspection only, with precomputed data preferred for renders. chroma.js is optional for color validation. HyperFrames is the default pipeline for timing, audio sync, validation, snapshots, and export. Remotion is a fallback only with a recorded reason. Verify frames, direct seeks, and audio sync before delivery.
